title: Upload Test Results fails with ECONNREFUSED artifact upload error after CPU functional tests pass

failed_jobs.symptom: All 71707 smoke tests passed, but the 'Upload Test Results' step failed with ECONNREFUSED while uploading the test-results-functional-cpu artifact.

If you are using self-hosted runners, please make sure your runner has access to all GitHub endpoints: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/hosting-your-own-runners/managing-self-hosted-runners/about-self-hosted-runners#communication-between-self-hosted-runners-and-github
root_cause: The CPU functional tests themselves completed successfully (71707 smoke tests run, 59859 passed, 0 failures reported by the parallel test runner). The job only failed afterward because the 'Upload Test Results' step (ababushk/upload-artifact action) could not reach the GitHub Actions artifact service, receiving ECONNREFUSED while calling CreateArtifact. This is a transient connectivity issue between the self-hosted ARM64 runner and the GitHub Actions artifact upload endpoint, not a problem with the OpenVINO code or the merged PR #38655 (a GPU plugin CMake refactor unrelated to CPU functional test infrastructure). The downstream overall-status aggregation job then correctly reported failure because one of its upstream jobs failed.
reproduction_steps: Not reproducible locally; this is an infrastructure/network connectivity failure between the self-hosted runner and GitHub's artifact upload service, intermittent and runner/network dependent.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'CPU functional tests' job; the underlying test execution already succeeded and only the artifact upload needs to retry.
Consider wrapping the artifact upload step with a retry/backoff (e.g., using nick-fields/retry or similar) to tolerate transient ECONNREFUSED errors from the artifact service.
Monitor self-hosted ARM64 runner network health/egress to GitHub Actions service endpoints if this recurs frequently.
prevention_strategies: Add automatic retry logic around artifact upload/download steps on self-hosted runners, since these runners are more prone to transient network blips than GitHub-hosted runners. Track recurrence of 'Failed to CreateArtifact' errors across patterns to decide if a permanent retry wrapper is warranted for this job.
historical_context: Similar network-related artifact upload failures have been seen before with different underlying DNS/connection errors: ENOTFOUND (pattern 4e9cf236bf92d555, 1 occurrence) and getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN (pattern d877f2bb57b833d0, 2 occurrences) during artifact uploads after tests had already passed. This is the first occurrence of the specific ECONNREFUSED variant, suggesting a broader recurring theme of transient network instability affecting the GitHub Actions artifact upload service for this repository's self-hosted runners, rather than isolated incidents.
